title: Availability Guarantees and the Span over which Approved Kiosk Outage is Read
content:
A run of approved kiosk outage requests on an Unattended Micro Market Program agreement can widen the span over which those hours are read, and the availability the market format guarantees settles how far.

## The clause

1. Where the market format guarantees kiosk availability at or above 97.5 per cent of opening hours, and the agreement carries at or above 5 approved kiosk outage requests over the three months to the day the credit is worked out, the hours are read over the six months to that day.
2. Where the market format guarantees kiosk availability below 97.5 per cent of opening hours, and the agreement carries at or above 5 approved kiosk outage requests over those three months, the hours are read over the twelve months to that day.
3. Where the agreement carries fewer than 5 approved kiosk outage requests over those three months, no such widening is made.

## The boundaries

The high uptime guarantee is 97.5 per cent of opening hours: a format guaranteeing exactly 97.5 per cent is at or above it, and a format guaranteeing 97 per cent is below it. The busy outage count is 5 approved kiosk outage requests over the three months to the day the credit is worked out: exactly 5 meets it, 4 does not.

| Availability guaranteed by the format | Approved kiosk outage requests over the three months | Hours are read over |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 97.5 per cent or more | 5 or more | the six months to that day |
| below 97.5 per cent | 5 or more | the twelve months to that day |
| any | 4 or fewer | no such widening is made |

*Hypothetical.* An agreement on a format guaranteeing 98 per cent, carrying 6 approved kiosk outage requests in the quarter, reads its hours over the six months to that day. The same run of 6 requests on a format guaranteeing 96 per cent reads them over the twelve months to that day.
